crops.name: Palak
crops.tip: Patte torhte raho, poda dobara ugta rehta hai. Katayi wali fasal hai — ek dafa lagao, mahino khao.
crops.water: Roz halka pani, mitti nam rakho

crops.name: Methi
crops.tip: Beej ghana bo'o — methi bheer me khush rehti hai. 3 inch ki ho jaye to kaat lo.

crops.name: Dhania
crops.sun: Halki dhoop — tez dhoop me jaldi beej pakar leta hai
crops.tip: Gamlay ke liye sab se behtreen! Beej ko halka masal kar bo'o — do tukre ugte hain. Thora thora kaat-te raho.

crops.name: Mooli
crops.tip: Gehra gamla lo (8 inch). Beej door door bo'o taake mooli moti bane.
crops.water: Barabar pani — sookhi mitti me cheerh (crack) par jati hai

crops.name: Gajar
crops.tip: Mitti me kankar na ho warna gajar terhi hogi. Sabar wali fasal hai, lekin meethi apni ugayi hui!
crops.water: Halka roz — retli naram mitti lazmi

crops.name: Shalgam
crops.tip: Patte bhi pakte hain — do faide ek poda. Thand me meetha banta hai.

crops.name: Matar
crops.tip: Bail charhti hai — dandi ya jaali ka sahara do. Phool aaye to pani barha do.

crops.name: Lehsan
crops.tip: Bazar wale lehsan ki kali dabao, nok upar. Sabar chahiye — April/May me niklegi, lekin apni hogi!
crops.water: Kam pani — zyada pani se sarh jata hai

crops.name: Bhindi
crops.tip: Roz torho — ek din chhoro to sakht ho jati hai. Garmi ki wafadar sabzi.

crops.name: Mirch
crops.tip: Gamlay me sab se khush! Paneeri February me lagao. Jitni dhoop, utni teekhi.

crops.name: Tamatar
crops.tip: Bara gamla (12 inch) lo aur dandi ka sahara do. Neeche wale peele patte torhte raho.
crops.water: Roz, jarh me — patton par pani na dalo

crops.name: Karela
crops.tip: Bail hai — deewar ya jaali par charhao. Karwa zaroor, faide wala zaroor.

crops.name: Kheera
crops.tip: Mitti hamesha nami wali rakho. Bail ko zameen par phelne do ya jaali do.
crops.water: Roz — pyasa poda karwa kheera deta hai

crops.name: Podina
crops.tip: Beej nahi, tehni lagao — bazar ke podine ki dandi pani me rakho, jarh niklegi. Alag gamlay me rakho, warna sab par qabza kar lega!

crops.name: Baingan
crops.tip: Bara gamla lo. Phool giraye to ghabrao nahi — pehle phool aksar girte hain.

crops.name: Band Gobhi
crops.tip: Paneeri September me tayyar karo, October me zameen me muntaqil karo. Sardi jitni, gobhi utni meethi.

general_tips: Beej hamesha taza lo — purana beej aadha ugta hai.
Gamlay me neeche surakh (drainage) lazmi hai, warna jarh sarh jati hai.
Mitti: aam bhal mitti + gobar ki khad (50/50) har sabzi ke liye kaafi hai.
Roz 4-6 ghante dhoop sab se zaroori khad hai.
meta.note: Curated starter guide, not an agronomy textbook. Sowing windows are for Karachi's climate (mild winter Nov-Feb, hot summer, monsoon Jul-Sep). When in doubt, ask your local nursery wala — woh sab se bara expert hai.
meta.watering_october: October me Karachi abhi garam rehta hai — pani subah ke waqt do, taake shaam tak mitti halki sookh jaye. Geelay patte raat bhar rehne se keerha lagta hai.
